description: Plan a frozen H3 container deployment set without pulling or recreating services.

action.summary: Freeze exact services and immutable target image digests

checks: Actor is authorized to plan H3 container maintenance
Only explicitly allowlisted services can enter the plan
Stateful dependency, backup, interruption, and rollback requirements are recorded
Plan enumerates exact service names and current and target image digests
Plan defines ordered health checks and retained rollback digests
Plan receives an immutable SHA-256 digest
No image is pulled and no container is changed

rollback.note: Planning changes no system state; the frozen plan must identify retained prior image digests.
